title: feat(boundaries)!: add "Do not touch" face/edge protection on 2D Offset and 3D Pocket
body:
Stacked on #2077 (merge #2077 first)

## What changed
- Added **Do not touch** protected faces, patches, and edge chains plus standoff **Clearance** (`>= 0.0` mm, default `0.0`) to `AreaControls` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs`, `area.rs`).
- Separated `has_boundary_edits()` from `is_default()` so empty protection preserves legacy toolpaths, boundary clipping, and generation stamps (`op_stamp` hashes `camcraft-do-not-touch-v1` only when protection is active).
- Added independent 3D full-tool keep-out generation and swept verification in `crates/sim/src/verify/` (`avoid.rs`, `avoid_poly.rs`, `avoid_links.rs`, `swept.rs`, `probe.rs`, `Warning::AvoidHit`), checking flutes, shank, and holder against `clearance + max(stock_to_leave, 0)` and elevating obstructed rapid traverses.
- Wired per-level keep-outs, `KeepDown` link chord checks (`prev_center` / `prev_state`), and impossible-room refusals into `2D Offset` (`machining2d::pocket_avoid`) and `3D Pocket` (`machining3d::pocket3d_avoid`, `shell.rs`, `ladder.rs`, `entry.rs`), plus upright `route_links` and upright/tilted `verify_avoid` in `generate.rs`.
- Added live post-gate checks (`live_avoid_problems` in `posting.rs`) so violated or stale/overlapping protected items block NC posting.
- Added undoable `SetOperationDoNotTouch`, overlap and vertex validation across `EditOperationParams`, `SetOperationGeometry`, `ChangeOperationKind`, and `EditOperationLinks`, MCP tools `get_operation_do_not_touch` / `set_operation_do_not_touch`, and refused non-default `"Do not touch"` on unsupported operation kinds by name.
- Rendered `"Do not touch"` UI controls, rows with `"×"` remove + viewport hover highlight, and persistent selection viewport overlays (`crates/ui/src/avoid_viz.rs`, `egui_app/boundary.rs`, `boundary_draft.rs`).
- Bumped `PROJECT_VERSION` `63 -> 64` (stacked on `#2077`) so pre-v64 readers refuse files carrying `"do_not_touch"` rather than ignoring protection.
- Updated `site/content/guide/` docs, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, and `docs/decisions/2055-do-not-touch.md`.

## UI review evidence (#2149)

Review-fix head: `928c878dbcdae917f1de9523213caeb1874b451d`. Merged `upstream/main` at `a49322b9c0c049bd0b3b2d1dea855de6087ac64b`; kept the cutting-data and Weldon holder descriptions. Both new commits carry `Fixes #2055`.

Validation of this head: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (53.0 min, 5 steps, 0 failed). Clippy on tools, sim, motion, app, and ui, all targets with `-D warnings`, passed.

The same 2200 × 1200 scene and camera are used in both captures. Before renders the pre-feature parent Boundary source (`dfbc9b18a^`) in the merged shell, with the protection overlay disabled. After renders the current PR UI. The after view shows the protected face and edge-chain rows, Clearance 1.25 mm, and viewport protection marks. These are GPU-rendered shell captures; no screenshot or capture harness is committed on this PR branch.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: parent Boundary UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/37652ad68277c01babd8fb2996b41ed38e4cc7bd/2149/before.png) | ![After: protected rows, clearance, and viewport marks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/37652ad68277c01babd8fb2996b41ed38e4cc7bd/2149/after.png) |

The structural pin `geometry_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_rows_and_viewport_marks` also checks that both protected-item descriptions appear below Clearance in selection order. Mutation: hide the row descriptions → RED; restore → GREEN.

## Cause
Users needed a way on the Geometry tab (`Boundary` -> `Boundaries`) to pick model faces or edge chains that no cut, plunge, ramp, helix, keep-down link, or rapid move could touch or approach within clearance across the full tool assembly (flutes, shank, holder). Previously, `AreaControls` only supported 2D XY machining/containment boundary regions without 3D Z-aware full-stack keep-outs, rapid elevation, or post-blocking `AvoidHit` checks.

## Tests
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: `wall 30.8 min, 5 step(s), 0 failed` (`tools 0s`, `sim 23s`, `motion 700s`, `app 1071s`, `ui 39s`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green (`0` warnings/errors).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test verify_avoid`: `2 passed; 0 failed` (`detects_axial_holder_and_edge_clearance_violations`, `detects_zero_clearance_graze_and_link_obstruction`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test avoid_pocket`: `3 passed; 0 failed` (`empty_avoid_matches_plain_paths_exactly`, `pocket_avoid_all_strategies_entries_holder_and_edge`, `pocket3d_avoid_shell_rest_and_adaptive_stay_clear`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch`: `3 passed; 0 failed` (`offset2d_do_not_touch_keeps_full_tool_clear_of_protected_face_and_edge`, `pocket3d_do_not_touch_keeps_clear_raises_links_and_blocks_impossible_cut`, `do_not_touch_post_gate_blocks_violations_and_project_v64_persists`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib do_not_touch`: `2 passed; 0 failed` (`geometry_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_rows_and_viewport_marks`, `unsupported_op_shows_do_not_touch_note_without_pick_button`).
- Mutation checks (reverted to old behavior/bypassed, verified red, restored, verified green):
  1. `crates/sim/src/verify/avoid.rs::avoid_hits` returning `Ok(Vec::new())` -> `verify_avoid` failed (`0 passed; 2 failed`) -> restored green.
  2. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` bypassing `pocket_avoid` on `Offset2D` -> `offset2d_do_not_touch_keeps_full_tool_clear_of_protected_face_and_edge` failed with `flute` and `shank` violations -> restored green.
  3. `crates/app/src/commands/operation/do_not_touch.rs` bypassing `avoid_overlap_issue` -> `pocket3d_do_not_touch_keeps_clear_raises_links_and_blocks_impossible_cut` failed (accepted overlapping pick) -> restored green.
  4. `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs::Warning::blocks_post` exempting `Warning::AvoidHit` -> `do_not_touch_post_gate_blocks_violations_and_project_v64_persists` failed (`cached AvoidHit must block post`) -> restored green.

## Goldens moved
None (`git diff --stat base-2077 -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty). Note: `wire_4axis_punch.nc`/`.cl` appear in a raw diff against `upstream/main` only because `upstream/main` merged `#1921` after stack base `#2077`.

## Not exercised
- Full `xtask gate release` (nightly/heavy gate) was not run; `xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` ran cleanly.
- End-to-end app test on tilted 3+2 `Offset2D` with `Do not touch` (`Some(f)` arm in `generate.rs`) was reviewed in code (`collect_items` + `verify_avoid` run in tilted job frame) rather than given a dedicated app test.
- Interactive desktop viewport mouse picking was covered via `egui_kittest` (`take_pick` + `avoid_viz::avoid_marks` + UI controls) rather than manual GUI execution.

## Overlaps
- Stack base **#2077**: touches `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` (`PROJECT_VERSION` bumped `62 -> 63` there, `63 -> 64` here) and `commands/mod.rs`, `commands/operation/edit.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs`, `project/{apply.rs,mod.rs}`, `ui/src/{egui_app/tests.rs,state.rs}` — merge `#2077` first.
- Same function/signature adjacency (whichever merges second refreshes): **#2035** (`crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs::ladder` and `entry.rs` trailing argument `stock` vs `avoid`); **#2092, #2101, #2126, #2134, #2136, #2140** (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs::PROJECT_VERSION`).
- Same file, different functions (whichever merges second refreshes): **#2138** (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs` `RapidInStock` vs `AvoidHit`; `crates/ui/src/operations.rs`); **#1713, #1738, #1798, #1817, #2013, #2037, #2081, #2083, #2089, #2091, #2093, #2110, #2129, #2141** (`generate.rs`, `edit.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs`, `shell.rs`, `tests.rs`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`).
